user_impact: On a weak connection an answer can fail to save while the screen still shows it selected. It is then submitted as unanswered. Frequency unknown; likely on mobile data.
steps_to_reproduce: Signed in as a student, start an assessment. In browser dev tools set the network to Offline, choose an answer on question 2, set the network back to Online, answer questions 3 to 5, submit. Compare the result report with the answers chosen.
expected: A failed save is retried automatically or the student is told clearly which answer is not saved; the warning clears when saving works again; submit refuses or retries until all answers are saved.
observed: By code: setError is never reset to an empty string; saves are chained with previous.catch(() => {}) so an earlier failed save is never retried; submit awaits only the latest save. saveResponse does not call recordFailure.
evidence: app/(app)/student/attempt/[id]/page.tsx lines 110-150 (answer, submit); lib/api/assessment.ts 74-92; see 06 section 1
root_cause_confidence: High on the code path; behaviour not yet reproduced in a browser
recommended_ux: Per-question save state (saved / saving / not saved, retry). Plain banner that clears on the next success. Submit shows how many answers are unsaved.
technical_proposal: Keep a Map of unsaved answers; retry with backoff and on the browser online event; await all pending saves at submit; clear error on success; call recordFailure on save errors. Extract the save queue into a small tested module.
dependencies_risks: Touches assessment integrity: needs a database-side idempotency check (qb_save_response upsert) and approval before release.
acceptance_criteria: With the network offline for one answer and restored, all answers appear in the result; the banner clears; failures are logged to operations.
regression_tests: Unit tests for the save queue (fail then succeed, fail twice, submit while pending); Playwright offline scenario on Preview.
status: IMPLEMENTED IN CODE, UNVERIFIED: needs a signed-in session; not deployed. Retrying save queue (lib/assessment/save-queue.ts, 7 unit tests), save state banner, unsaved marker on question dots, submit waits for all saves, warning before leaving with unsaved answers. Reproduce the offline scenario on Preview before release.

observed: Home, terms, contact, login and every help guide returned 'private, no-cache, no-store' with x-vercel-cache MISS. /pricing, /help and /challenges returned 'public, max-age=0, must-revalidate' with HIT or STALE. Home: move the email-link redirect (hasAuthLinkParams) and the session-cookie check into middleware.ts so the page itself is static. technical_proposal: Set SITE_URL to https://www.quizbox.io (or move the redirect the other way); add /favicon.ico or an icon route.

acceptance_criteria: canonical, og:url and sitemap all use the served host.
regression_tests: Test that SITE_URL host equals the primary domain.

recommended_ux: Branded preview card with the QuizBox logo, tagline and, for challenges, the title and organiser.

dependencies_risks: Challenge pages must not expose private content in the card.
acceptance_criteria: Facebook Sharing Debugger and WhatsApp show a wide branded preview for the home page and a challenge link.
regression_tests: Test that metadata exports an image of the right size.
status: IMPLEMENTED, PARTLY VERIFIED: the home page now serves a generated PNG card (200, image/png, 41 KB) and summary_large_image; challenge and competition cards fall back to the general card for missing or private items (200, 32 KB). type: Defect (found while fixing UX-001; calculated, then covered by a test)
user_impact: White text on the amber-to-red band and the green-to-sky band is hard to read. axe does not measure text on a gradient, so it never flagged it.
steps_to_reproduce: Calculate white against each gradient stop: #f59e0b = 2.15:1, #0ea5e9 = 2.8:1, #059669 = 3.8:1, #ef4444 = 3.8:1.
expected: At least 4.5:1 at every stop for normal text, 3:1 for large text.
observed: Sponsor band (#f59e0b to #ef4444) and schools band (#059669 to #0ea5e9) fail for the button text and the smaller band text.
recommended_ux: Same hues, darker stops.
technical_proposal: Schools #047857 to #0369a1; sponsors #c2410c to #b91c1c; unit test over every stop.
dependencies_risks: The sponsor band is now burnt orange instead of amber; confirm the look with the owner.
acceptance_criteria: All stops at least 4.5:1 against white.
status: FIXED IN CODE, VERIFIED BY TEST: stops darkened (schools #047857 to #0369a1, sponsors #c2410c to #b91c1c); 6 unit tests. Owner to approve the burnt-orange look.
